name: Pythilo
subtitle: Python IDE, course and labs
promotionalText: New: 32 algorithm lessons linked to Labs, GitHub search with your private repos, and project categories. 478 lessons and 136 Labs, fully offline once downloaded.
description:
Real Python, on your iPhone and iPad.

Pythilo combines a Python IDE, courses and interactive Labs. CPython 3.14 runs on your device. Explicitly download a complete course or Lab category, then read, run, check and train entirely offline. Download everything prepares the whole library.

A complete workspace
• Multi-file projects, folders, a touch editor, completion and diagnostics.
• input(), clear tracebacks, Stop, breakpoints, stepping and variables.
• A terminal with tabs, pipes, redirects, pytest, pip, Git, sqlite3 and npm.
• Keep a Django or FastAPI server running in one tab while you migrate, test or commit in another.
• Git commits, branches, diffs, merge, rebase and HTTPS clone.
• Search GitHub from Clone with stars, owners and languages, or save your GitHub account to clone your own repositories, private ones included.
• Search projects, sort them and group them into categories.
• Ordinary .ipynb notebooks and a SQLite browser.

Download what you use
• Choose Download entire course or Download entire Lab category; all lessons, checks and required assets are saved together.
• Nothing downloads when creating, opening or running projects. Choose Download project packages explicitly.
• See sizes and progress; pause, resume, cancel or remove downloads.
• Removing downloads preserves project code, lesson drafts and progress.
• Compiled Python backends remain in the signed app; their Python APIs download separately.

Web and machine learning
• Django, Flask, FastAPI, Pydantic, Starlette and Uvicorn on the device.
• Start a local server and open its preview. Build React with esbuild.
• NumPy, PyTorch, SymPy and NetworkX, plus per-project pure-Python pip packages.
• Real PyTorch CPU training and Core ML inference from Python.
• Six complete pretrained BERT projects: full fine-tuning, query/value LoRA, domain transfer, budget comparisons, exact checkpoint recovery and merged-model export.
• The UCI review dataset, tokenizer and pretrained weights download once and are shared between projects. Training and evaluation run locally.

Learn by writing code
• 478 lessons in 38 courses, plus 100 timed interview tasks.
• Courses grouped into Python, web and data, machine learning, AI and algorithms tracks; search every lesson by name.
• Algorithms and data structures: 32 lessons from binary search and sorting to heaps, tries, union-find, BFS, Dijkstra, dynamic programming, N-Queens and KMP.
• Python foundations, architecture, async, testing, Pydantic, HTTP APIs, mathematics, ML, transformers and AI systems.
• Runnable examples, hints, worked answers and checks that explain failures. Pass the checks and the next lesson is one tap away.
• 138 advanced lessons with 34 integration projects.

See your algorithms work
• Senior CPU Labs: SAM, PCGrad, Group DRO, heteroscedastic uncertainty, QAT, DPO/GRPO mechanisms, sparse MoE and exact speculative sampling.
• Four complete synthetic-data projects train, select, evaluate, export and reload models offline.
• 136 Labs in 19 topics: 65 ML and 48 AI Labs.
• Search by concept, trace your own code and replay each step.
• 127 Labs link to the lessons that teach them. 74 Labs also run in the free browser playground.

Work together
• Encrypted rooms with live edits and cursors. Remote execution needs device-owner permission.
• Connect an AI client over your local network or through a room.
• No Pythilo account, analytics or advertising. Your projects stay yours; a GitHub account is optional.

Made for iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape, keyboard and touch.

Limits: no Node.js, Jupyter server, pandas, Matplotlib or SciPy. PyTorch uses CPU; no MPS or torch.compile. iOS pauses servers in the background.
betaDescription: Pythilo is a Python IDE with 446 lessons, 100 interview tasks and 136 Labs. Choose Download entire course, Download entire Lab category or Download everything. Every selection includes the packages, datasets and model weights it needs, then reading, code execution, checks and training run entirely offline. Creating, opening or running a project never starts a download. Project source stays local; choose Download project packages yourself. Progress, pause, resume and removal are available. Six complete pretrained BERT/LoRA projects train and evaluate on CPU. No account is needed. The beta is free; release price remains $9.99. New senior Labs include SAM, PCGrad, Group DRO, DPO/GRPO mechanisms and sparse MoE. Four complete synthetic-data experiments add validation selection, leakage checks, actual exports and fresh reloads.
whatToTest: Build 33 adds GitHub search to Clone (stars, owners, languages), an optional GitHub account in Settings that lists your repositories including private ones, project search, sorting and categories, and a 32-lesson Algorithms and data structures course linked to its Labs (Learn > Algorithms). It also fixes the Labs download controls on narrow iPhones.
reviewNotes: Pythilo embeds CPython 3.14 and runs the user's own code locally as an educational and development tool. No account or login is required, and there are no in-app purchases. To try: Projects > New project > CSV Cleaner, open main.py and tap Run; open the Terminal and run pytest. Terminal tabs: Projects > New project > Django notes > Terminal, tap runserver, then tap + for a second tab and run python manage.py test; the server keeps running. Projects can be searched and put into categories (touch and hold a project > Category). Clone > Search queries GitHub's public API without an account; signing in to GitHub (Settings > GitHub account) is optional, uses the person's own personal access token stored in the Keychain, and only lists and clones their repositories. Learn offers runnable lessons with checks, including the Algorithms and data structures course; Labs traces the user's own algorithms. Course and Lab content downloads only after an explicit Download action (Learn or Labs > Download); creating, opening or running a project never downloads anything. pip installs pure-Python packages from PyPI only when the user requests it; compiled backends are bundled and signed, and their Python APIs download separately. npm fetches packages and esbuild builds them without Node.js. The built-in preview opens local web servers. The Local Network permission supports local servers and MCP connections initiated by the user. Shared rooms use https://pythilo.com, carry end-to-end encrypted project data, and require device-owner permission for remote run requests. There are no analytics or advertising SDKs.
